description:
Six holders spell "outcome -> body_id -> target" four ways: jobs/native.rs:2882-2890 and :1928-1933, ir_interp/backend.rs:801, :1098-1106, :2496-2506, ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs:585-587. OutcomeId <-> body_id is a bijection (one construction site, pattern.rs:611-625, one Unique outcome per row, validate_source_rows enforces strictly monotonic body ids). ExecutableDispatch::clause_index does a linear position() per interpreted call and DispatchCallArm lookup a linear find per dispatched call.

Change: PatternDispatchPlan::body_id(outcome) plus one BodyTable<T> newtype with get(body_id) collapses the six chains to one-liners and retires the scans. A full Dispatch<Target> fold of the holders touches 33 references in 8 files for less gain and is not recommended as one motion. Signal: the per-door fixture matrix; a unit test that the table's index equals the plan's outcome order.
title: One body table for the six outcome-to-body lookups
